svg.title: How GRESO turns OCO-2 soundings into a growth rate, in five steps
svg.desc: Five-step diagram: OCO-2 10-second soundings are binned into 5-degree, 16-day grid cells, averaged into one area-weighted global value every 16 days, stripped of the seasonal cycle and smoothed, and then differenced between the first days of months or years to give the growth rate.
svg.text: Output: monthly and annual whole-atmosphere (column) CO₂ growth rate from OCO-2 (GRESO) in ppm per year; × 2.124 = PgC per year.
